instructions.title: Crust
items: Mix pretzels, butter, and 3 Tbsp sugar and press into the bottom of a 9x13-inch pan.

instructions.title: Cream cheese layer
items: Blend cream cheese, powdered sugar, and Cool Whip.

instructions.title: Raspberry layer
items: Make jello with two cups boiling water.
Add 1 cup ice cubes and stir until dissolved.
Add raspberries and spread over cream cheese layer when it starts to thicken.
